description: brite-core hooks — brain-first guidance injection (SessionStart plain text + SubagentStart JSON envelope) plus the centralized security/quality guardrails shared across Brite plugins.

hooks.command: GUIDANCE="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/team-gbrain-usage.md"; if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'brite-core SubagentStart: jq not found — brain-first guidance not injected' >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -r "$GUIDANCE" ]; then echo "brite-core SubagentStart: guidance file unreadable ($GUIDANCE)" >&2; exit 0; fi; jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SubagentStart", additionalContext: .}}' "$GUIDANCE"

INPUT=$(cat); printf '%s\n' "$INPUT" | grep -Eiq 'rm[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f|rm[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*r|git[[:space:]]+push.*[[:space:]]-f|git[[:space:]]+push.*--force([[:space:]]|"|$)|drop[[:space:]]+(table|database)|chmod[[:space:]]+777|(curl|wget)[^"]*[|][[:space:]]*(bash|sh|zsh)' && echo '{"ok":false,"reason":"Blocked: destructive command detected (rm -rf, force push, DROP, chmod 777, or piped download)"}' || echo '{"ok":true}'

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s
' "$INPUT" | grep -o '"command":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/"command":"//;s/"//'); if ! printf '%s
' "$CMD" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|$)'; then echo '{"ok":true}'; exit 0; fi; advised=0; advise(){ if [ "$advised" -eq 0 ]; then printf '%s
' '⚠️  Pre-commit advisory: quality checks reported issues below (commit will proceed). Run linters locally or check CI to verify.' >&2; advised=1; fi; }; OLD_IFS=$IFS; IFS=$'
'; staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -z "$staged" ]; then IFS=$OLD_IFS; echo '{"ok":true}'; exit 0; fi; if [ -f package.json ]; then js_files=''; for f in $staged; do case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx) if [ -n "$js_files" ]; then js_files="$js_files\0$f"; else js_files="$f"; fi ;; esac; done; if [ -n "$js_files" ]; then if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx --no-install eslint --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then eslint_out=$(printf '%b' "$js_files" | xargs -0 npx --no-install eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern -- 2>&1) || { advise; printf '── ESLint ──
%s
' "$eslint_out" >&2; }; fi; if [ -f tsconfig.json ] && command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx --no-install tsc --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then tsc_out=$(npx --no-install tsc --noEmit 2>&1) || { advise; printf '── tsc --noEmit ──
%s
' "$tsc_out" >&2; }; fi; fi; fi; if [ -f pyproject.toml ] || [ -f setup.py ]; then py_files=''; for f in $staged; do case "$f" in *.py) if [ -n "$py_files" ]; then py_files="$py_files\0$f"; else py_files="$f"; fi ;; esac; done; if [ -n "$py_files" ] && command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff_out=$(printf '%b' "$py_files" | xargs -0 ruff check -- 2>&1) || { advise; printf '── ruff check ──
%s
' "$ruff_out" >&2; }; fi; fi; IFS=$OLD_IFS; echo '{"ok":true}'

INPUT=$(cat); printf '%s\n' "$INPUT" | grep -Eq 'sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|sk-proj-[a-zA-Z0-9]{10,}|AKIA[A-Z0-9]{12,}|gh[ps]_[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|sk_(live|test)_[a-zA-Z0-9]{10,}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|xox[abprs]-[a-zA-Z0-9-]{10,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}' && echo '{"ok":false,"reason":"Blocked: potential secret or API key detected in file content"}' || echo '{"ok":true}'

INPUT=$(cat); file_path=$(printf '%s\n' "$INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/"file_path":"//;s/"//'); [ -z "$file_path" ] && exit 0; ext="${file_path##*.}"; case "$ext" in js|jsx|ts|tsx) command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx --no-install eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern -- "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true ;; py) command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff check --fix -- "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; exit 0
